FROM pgroup_price_settings LEFT JOIN pgroup_companies AS pc ON pc.pgroup_id = pgroup_price_settings.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = pc.company_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = pgroup_price_settings.price_type_id LEFT JOIN pgroups AS pg ON pg.id = pgroup_price_settings.pgroup_id LEFT JOIN pgroups AS parent_pg ON parent_pg.id = pg.parent_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = pgroup_price_settings.created_by
